sentences.text: Author: D. Dash Bench: D. Dash  ABLAPL NO.15369 OF 2020 06. 25.06.2021 The matter is taken up through video conferencing  mode.

The petitioner having been implicated in Cuttack Sadar  P.S. Case No.624 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. Case  No.2710 of 2020 on the file of learned J.M.F.C.(R), Cuttack  for alleged commission of offence under sections  272/273/420/34, I.P.C. read with sections  51/52/53/56/57/59/63 of the Food Safety Standards Act,
 2006, Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
 1954of the IPC and section 32 of the Legal Metrology  Packaging of Commodities Rule, 2011 has filed this  application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in  the event of his arrest in the said case.

entities.text: Legal Metrology  Packaging of Commodities Rule, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Asok Mohanty, learned Senior Counsel for  the Petitioner and Mr. S.K. Nayak, learned Additional  Government Advocate.
Perused the F.I.R. and other connected documents filed  by the Petitioner as well as the State.
I have also gone  through the additional affidavit of the Petitioner and as also  the written note filed from the side of the State.

Considering the submissions made and taking note of  the serious nature of accusations as to the wide ranged  manufacturing activity carried out by the Petitioner which is  said to be having serious affect on the health and life of  public at large; this Court is of the view that custodial  // 2 //
 interrogation of the Petitioner in order to ascertain all such  detail activities carried out in the process of manufacturing  and the dealing of the products in open market with their  actual purpose and intent as also the verification of all such  required documents in presence of the Petitioner here in the  case is imperative for a fair investigation.

For the aforesaid,
 this Court does not find it to be a fit case for grant of pre-  arrest bail to the Petitioner.

As the restrictions due to resurgence of COVID-19 ABLAPL/15369/2020 on 25 June, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50231993/
1  situation are continuing, learned counsel for the parties may  utilize a printout of the order available in the High Court's  website, at par with certified copy, subject to attestation by  the concerned advocate, in the manner prescribed, vide  Court's Notice No.4587, dated 25th March, 2020 as modified  by Court's Notice No.4798 dated 15th April, 2021.
 ..........................
 D. Dash, J.
